verdict.rationale: RingCentral ships automation surfaces, including a no-code Workflow Builder, call handling rules and an agentic voice AI platform, so versioning and rollback is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents version history, review, or rollback for those automations. Mentions of the Workflow Builder and call handling configurations show only that automations exist, not that they can be versioned or rolled back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
